_doc: Gift odds by walk length. A walk shorter than min_seconds gives no gift. The highest tier whose min_seconds the walk reaches is used. Legendary starts at 45 minutes. 'guaranteed' is when each rarity becomes the minimum gift: the walk screen's gift button fills with that rarity's colour as the walk approaches it, and rarities below it drop out of the odds. Pity: after pity_walks walks of at least pity_min_seconds without an epic or legendary, the next such walk is guaranteed at least epic.
